description: Private fork configuration: Renovate only tracks the kindnetd image.
Everything else in this repository follows upstream microshift-io/microshift.
No automerge: kindnet is the pod network, a merge only rebuilds the RPM in
COPR (copr-stable.yaml); the host is upgraded by hand.
Image references stay digest-only: skopeo and CRI-O reject tag@digest, so
the tag lives in a comment (kustomization) and in release.base (JSON).

customManagers.description: kustomization.<arch>.yaml: tag in the renovate comment, digest below it.
release-kindnet-<arch>.json: tag in release.base, digest in the image reference.

packageRules.description: kindnetd tags are v<YYYYMMDD>-<commit>; the date is the version.
